components.name: Primary button
components.description: Save an alias or confirm restoration.
components.css: .ds-primary { font: 650 13px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; min-height: 40px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: #a8efc5; color: #153b2a; cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary:hover { background: #baf5d3; } .ds-primary:active { background: #8fe2b2; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a8efc5; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Look up loaded conversation names or cancel restoration.
components.css: .ds-secondary { font: 13px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; min-height: 40px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid #33453b; border-radius: 8px; background: #1c2b23; color: #dce8e1; cursor: pointer; } .ds-secondary:hover { background: #293d30; border-color: #597664; } .ds-secondary:active { background: #324c3c; } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a8efc5; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text field
components.description: Original conversation name or local alias.
components.html: <input class="ds-field" aria-label="Original name" placeholder="Exact name in WhatsApp">
components.css: .ds-field { font: 13px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; min-height: 42px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid #33453b; border-radius: 8px; background: #17231f; color: #e8eeec; caret-color: #a8efc5; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: #a3b6aa; opacity: 1; } .ds-field:hover { border-color: #597664; } .ds-field:focus { border-color: #a8efc5; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a8efc5; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Switch
components.html: <input class="ds-switch" type="checkbox" role="switch" aria-label="Blur open conversation">
components.css: .ds-switch { appearance: none; position: relative; width: 38px; height: 24px; margin: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: #42554b; cursor: pointer; } .ds-switch::before { content: ""; position: absolute; width: 16px; height: 16px; top: 4px; left: 4px; border-radius: 50%; background: #eef6f1; } .ds-switch:checked { background: #43b87a; } .ds-switch:checked::before { transform: translateX(14px); } .ds-switch:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #aebfb6; } .ds-switch:active { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #a8efc5; } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a8efc5; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Settings panel
components.description: Groups language, blur strength, readable area, and media settings.
components.css: .ds-panel { font: 13px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #33453b; border-radius: 12px; background: #17231f; color: #e8eeec; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-panel p { color: #aebfb6; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview: Preserve the existing dark green interface, mint actions, system typography, and approved logo. Use spacing, alignment, and visible control states to make settings easy to scan. Product copy stays factual and localized.
